## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Sentinel PE
2. Load file `...`
3. See error / unexpected behavior

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened. Include error messages if any.

## Environment
- Sentinel PE version: (e.g., v0.3.0)
- OS: (e.g., Windows 10 22H2, Windows 11 23H2)
- Sample type (if applicable): (e.g., x64 PE, DLL, packed EXE)

## Additional Context
Any other context about the problem. Screenshots welcome.

> **Note:** Do NOT attach malware samples to issues. Use SHA-256 hashes only.
